cards.title: The Office
cards.description: The office is half-decorated for tomorrow's celebration, and you're the one pulling it together. Three award stations wait down the hall — the same awards we give each other on our big nights. A note on the whiteboard reads: "Earn all three trophies to light the rooftop."
cards.image_prompt: Modern open-plan office at night, half-decorated for a Malaysia Day celebration with Jalur Gemilang bunting and string lights, three glowing award pedestals labelled with icons, festive but cozy, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Head to the first award station

cards.title: Peer Unicorn Station
cards.description: Peer Unicorn honours the colleague everyone leans on — the one who brings people together. So this station is all about connection: link Malaysia's states to their capitals.
cards.image_prompt: Playful office award station with a whimsical unicorn trophy motif, a wall panel of dangling colored wires connecting state names to city names, warm celebratory lighting, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Connect the states to their capitals

cards.title: States Connected!
cards.description: Every wire clicks home — states matched to capitals. One more challenge to claim the Peer Unicorn: spell out what unites them all.

cards.title: Peer Unicorn — Earned!
cards.description: B-E-R-S-E-K-U-T-U — 'united'. The letters lock into place and the unicorn trophy lights up. Peer Unicorn earned — on to the next station! 🦄

cards.title: 🦄 Peer Unicorn Trophy
cards.description: The Peer Unicorn trophy — proof you connect people like nobody else. One of three to collect tonight.

cards.title: Super Achiever Station
cards.description: Super Achiever honours the colleague who smashes every target. To earn it, celebrate Malaysia's own record-breakers — starting with the towers that once topped the world.
cards.image_prompt: Office award station with a soaring trophy motif and a large poster of the Petronas Twin Towers at night, a glowing numeric keypad on a pedestal, aspirational mood, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Enter the height of the towers

cards.title: Towers Raised!
cards.description: 452 metres — the keypad flashes green and the Petronas Twin Towers light up. One more challenge for the Super Achiever: prove you know Malaysia's greatest hits.

cards.title: Super Achiever — Earned!
cards.description: Three for three! Tallest in the world, then second-tallest, and the first Proton — you know your record-breakers. The Super Achiever trophy is yours — one more to go! 🏆

cards.title: 🏆 Super Achiever Trophy
cards.description: The Super Achiever trophy — proof you always reach higher. One of three to collect tonight.

cards.title: Beyond Boundaries Station
cards.description: Beyond Boundaries honours the colleague whose impact travels far and wide. To earn it, celebrate the Malaysian wonders the whole world knows — first its most famous dish, then its natural marvels.
cards.image_prompt: Office award station with a Malaysian wonders motif — steaming nasi lemak on banana leaf beside a small display of natural marvels (a mountain photo, a Rafflesia bloom, a tapir figurine) — a word-lock panel and a fact-check panel on a pedestal, warm inviting light, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Dish Named!
cards.description: NASI LEMAK — Malaysia's national dish, fragrant coconut rice with sambal. One final challenge for Beyond Boundaries: get the nature facts straight.

cards.title: Beyond Boundaries — Earned!
cards.description: Facts straight — Kinabalu's in Sabah, the tapir's black-and-white, and the Rafflesia is no sweet-smelling bloom! Malaysia's wonders know no borders, and neither do you. All three awards earned — to the rooftop! 🌺

cards.title: 🌺 Beyond Boundaries Trophy
cards.description: The Beyond Boundaries trophy — proof your impact travels far and wide. One of three to collect tonight.

cards.title: Rooftop Finale
cards.description: The rooftop, strung with lights and a Jalur Gemilang snapping in the night breeze. Three trophies in hand. One last question stands between you and the fireworks.
cards.image_prompt: Festive office rooftop at night, string lights and a large Malaysian flag, three glowing trophies on a table, fireworks about to launch over the Kuala Lumpur skyline, celebratory mood, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Set the date we celebrate tomorrow

cards.title: Selamat Hari Malaysia!
cards.description: 16 September! The fireworks erupt over the skyline. Tomorrow isn't Merdeka Day — it's Malaysia Day, the day Malaya, Sabah, Sarawak and Singapore became Malaysia in 1963. The celebration is lit. Happy Malaysia Day! 🇲🇾
